item.title: Version 1.2.0
item.description:
What's new

  • Window: a standard Mac sidebar, toolbar and inspector. The window no longer forces its size, and it remembers the page and panels you had open.
  • Settings: now a separate Settings window (⌘,) with tabs for General, Calendars, Capture, AI, Integrations, Data and Advanced.
  • Today: overdue tasks appear at the top with "Move all to today", and the day's schedule sits beside your task list.
  • Calendar: tasks with a time appear on the timeline and can be dragged and resized. Drag from the new Unscheduled strip to time-block a task. Overlapping items sit side by side.
  • Tasks: opening a task no longer jumps you to the Tasks page. Arrow keys, Space, Delete and Return work in task lists.
  • Undo: ⌘Z undoes your last planner actions, including edits, rescheduling and event moves.
  • Notes: the editor now types like an editor. Return, Backspace and arrow keys work across blocks, the / and @ menus filter as you type, and printing produces a formatted page. Notes can be starred.
  • Capture: the launcher, quick add, quick capture and menu-bar field all understand the same #tag, @date and &folder tokens.
  • Habits: a habit now shows as done only on the day you tick it.
  • Fixed: opening a "this week", "this month" or Someday task no longer moves it to the Inbox.
  • Fixed: editing or dragging one occurrence of a repeating event no longer affects the wrong occurrence, and saving an event keeps its alerts and location.
  • Fixed: the ⌥Space launcher shortcut now opens the launcher.
  • Safer: restoring a backup asks first and takes a safety backup. Emptying the Trash asks for confirmation. Sync no longer brings back tasks you deleted.
  • Changed: the Events page is removed (Upcoming shows the same events). "Proactive insights" is off unless you turn it on. Cloud AI keys are stored per provider, so you may be asked for your key again.
  • Readability: no text smaller than 11pt, better contrast, and times follow your 12/24-hour setting.
